labels.discrepant: Examined evidence conflicts with the claim or declared criterion; comparability limits remain explicit.
labels.inconclusive: Relevant evidence was examined but cannot resolve the claim within the declared scope.
labels.reproduced: The declared check meets its criterion under the recorded conditions; broader validity is not implied.
labels.untested: No adequate check has been completed; a plan or citation is not a test.
